name: Dispensary Districts 18 Apr 1926 (estimate)
description: An estimate of the dispensary districts of the Irish Free State at the census of 18 Apr 1926: the 573 districts as the 1936 census constituted them (CSO Census of Population 1936, Vol. 1, Table 10, which also prints each district's 1926 population), drawn on Paddy Matthews's 1926 District Electoral Division map. The 1926 report's own Table 10 is not held, so a district changed between 1926 and 1936 is shown as it was in 1936, and no district can be checked against a printed 1926 area. 553 districts are graded B (their 1936 composition verified) and 20 C: Droichead Nua and Kilcullen, which divide Ballysax East DED (placed whole in Kilcullen), and 18 that needed 1926 DEDs with no counterpart in the 1936 lists (mostly urban wards named or divided differently), placed by their printed reference numbers or by adjacency. Each district carries its grade and the reason for it (confidence, confidence_reason). The city dispensary districts of Dublin, Cork, Limerick and Waterford are not mapped: the census builds them from parts of DEDs and wards, so each county borough is shown as one unit, without a population. A district that crosses a county boundary is shown as one part per county, as the table prints it. Each district carries its 1926 population as printed in 1936, its Table 10 reference numbers and its DEDs.

references.label: Census of Population 1936, Vol. 1, Table 10: population, area and valuation of dispensary districts, registrars' districts and superintendent registrars' districts
references.note: The composition of each district as at 1936, by 1911 DED reference numbers, and its 1926 population as constituted in 1936. The 1926 Volume 1 Table 10 is not held, so the 1926 districts are estimated from it.
